name: Living Weapon
description: Made to destroy, struggling to be anything else
behavioral_signature: Defaults to violence because that's what they were designed for
under_stress: Becomes the weapon fully, all other identity falls away
at_rest: Tries awkwardly to be human, succeeds in small moments
will_always: respond to threats with disproportionate force
will_never: fully escape what they were made to be
unless: someone loves them enough to see past the weapon
